breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'the standard linear stress distribution from the flexure formula σ = M * y / I,' which correctly reflects the linear (not uniform) stress distribution. The incorrect instruction to treat the bending stress as uniform over the section depth has been removed, aligning with the ground truth prompt.
